findings_qualitative.value: Blue asymmetry in H12CO+ profiles of most leaves indicates infall

claims.hypothesis: Are dense structures near W42-MME turbulent and gravitationally bound?
claims.experiment: Dendrogram of H13CO+ with virial analysis

evidence.quote: These structures exhibit transonic–supersonic gas motions (1$<\mathcal{M}<5$) with overvirial states ($\alpha_{\rm vir}\geq2$).

claims.hypothesis: Does L17 satisfy conditions for massive star formation?
claims.experiment: Mass-size comparison to Kauffmann & Pillai threshold

evidence.quote: we noticed that only leaf L17 lies within this relation

claims.hypothesis: Hierarchical and chaotic collapse explains kinematics

evidence.quote: our results observationally support the hierarchical and chaotic collapse scenario in the proximity of the MYSO W42-MME

limitations_admitted.value: Mass uncertain by factor of few from dust emissivity; interferometric missing flux and gas-to-dust ratio may bias masses

evidence.quote: the interferometric observations are sensitive to strong and compact sources but miss more diffuse and extended emission

referee_caveats_inferred: Only 19 structures so correlations have low statistics
Large virial parameters may result from masses underestimated by missing flux
Dendrogram parameters affect results; no robustness test
